name: EDC Las Vegas: kineticFIELD
notes: Stage placed in the infield at the Turn 3-4 end of the Las Vegas Motor Speedway oval (jeffgluck.com: kineticFIELD is built between Turns 3 and 4), the audience looking north-east along the oval's long axis. The oval is measured; the stage itself is temporary and not in the lidar, so its exact spot and facing are estimated.
